ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, the lines $EF$ and $CD$ intersect at the point $O$, with $\angle AOB = 90^\circ$, and $OC$ bisects $\angle AOF$. If $\angle AOE = 40^\circ$, find the degree measure of $\angle BOD$.
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given $\because \angle AOE+\angle AOE=180^\circ$, $\angle AOE=40^\circ$,\\
$\therefore \angle AOF=180^\circ-\angle AOE=140^\circ$\\
Since $OC$ bisects $\angle AOF$,\\
$\therefore \angle AOC=\frac{1}{2}\angle AOF=\frac{1}{2}\times 140^\circ=70^\circ$\\
Given $\angle AOB=90^\circ$\\
$\therefore \angle BOD=180^\circ-\angle AOC-\angle AOB$\\
$=180^\circ-70^\circ-90^\circ$\\
$=\boxed{20^\circ}$

ready3_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: As shown in the figure, the lines $EF$ and $CD$ intersect at the point $O$, with $\angle AOB = 90^\circ$, and $OC$ bisects $\angle AOF$. If $\angle AOE = 40^\circ$, find the degree measure of $\angle BOD$.
ready3_open_rewrite.resolved_answer: \textbf{Solution:} Given $\because \angle AOE+\angle AOE=180^\circ$, $\angle AOE=40^\circ$,\\ $\therefore \angle AOF=180^\circ-\angle AOE=140^\circ$\\ Since $OC$ bisects $\angle AOF$,\\ $\therefore \angle AOC=\frac{1}{2}\angle AOF=\frac{1}{2}\times 140^\circ=70^\circ$\\ Given $\angle AOB=90^\circ$\\ $\therefore \angle BOD=180^\circ-\angle AOC-\angle AOB$\\ $=180^\circ-70^\circ-90^\circ$\\ $=\boxed{20^\circ}$
ready3_open_rewrite.final_cot:
First describe the image: In the figure, O is the intersection point, EF is a straight line, E is at the upper right of O, and F is at the lower left of O, so OE and OF are opposite rays; CD is another straight line, D is at the upper left of O, and C is at the lower right of O, so OC and OD are opposite rays. OA goes from O to the right, OB goes from O upward, and what is asked for in the figure is ∠BOD.

Then reason: It is known that ∠AOE = 40°. Because OE and OF are opposite rays, ∠AOE and ∠AOF are supplementary, obtaining ∠AOF = 180° - 40° = 140°. Also because OC bisects ∠AOF, ∠AOC = 140° ÷ 2 = 70°. It is known that ∠AOB = 90°. From the figure, OC to OD is a half-turn of a straight line, passing through OA and OB in sequence, therefore ∠AOC + ∠AOB + ∠BOD = 180°. So ∠BOD = 180° - 70° - 90° = 20°.
